fixture_source.adaptation: Original state, field descriptions and labels preserved. enum becomes Choice; boolean becomes Noul. No source-engine code is executed.

methodology.compute: Same resident frozen 4-bit Gemma weights, float32 compute, all 35 layers.
methodology.timing: One excluded warmup per method per case, then repeated runs in rotating/reversed order. GPU synchronized at boundaries. Medians include prompt preparation and inference; exclude model loading, upload, and allocator reset.
methodology.cache: Fresh input/media KV per run. Every scorer run prefills all state and question definitions once. Serial control changes only branch batch size to one, retaining the same shared prefix.
methodology.normal: Greedy compact JSON with decisions only, no reasoning or requested probabilities; same complete input and schema as the scorer. No padded output requirement.
methodology.quality: Predeclared development expectations are scored where available. Invalid structured responses count as failed decisions. Unannotated policy questions are compared only for agreement. Agreement does not establish accuracy.
methodology.input_limit_note: The 255-choice example exceeds the default 8192-token UI limit. This standalone benchmark raises the limit without truncating the schema for either method.

presentation: Designed replay of measured median completion times at real elapsed-time scale. Not a screen recording or token timing trace. Eight of 28 actual output values are displayed with human-readable labels; all values are retained here.
